name: DISTRICT_CONFIG
label: District configuration (JSON)
help: The directory the district starts from (the district, its trusted issuers, and at least the administrators who will import the roster), and optionally its funding pools, model catalog, record authority, retention and email sender (email.from, on a domain onboarded to Cloudflare Email Service in this account). Read only on first start, apart from the district ID. See packages/educateos-district-worker/README.md for the schema.

name: CF_ACCESS_ISS
label: Cloudflare Access team domain
help: https://<team>.cloudflareaccess.com, no trailing slash: the issuer of the Access assertions the district accepts. The district must list it in its trustedIssuers.

name: CF_ACCESS_AUD
label: Cloudflare Access audience
help: The audience tag of the Access application in front of the district's /api, and of the instance whose gatekeeper forwards sign-ins to it.
